title: Air-quality monitoring
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Accurately record the date, time, and location of all measurements.
3. Identify the source of emissions (company and facility name).
4. List the types of pollutants measured (e.g., SO2, NOx, CO, PM10, PM2.5, VOCs, etc.).
5. Use calibrated equipment and follow standard methods to measure pollutant concentrations accurately.
6. Record meteorological data (wind speed, direction, temperature, humidity) at the time of measurement, as these factors can affect emission dispersion.
7. Note the background levels of pollutants at the monitoring site.
8. Document any visible signs of pollution such as smoke, odors, or discolored clouds.
9. Record the duration and frequency of emission occurrences.
10. Compare the observed concentration levels with the permissible limits set by local, national, or international regulations.

11. In a separate section, analyze emission patterns, trends, and exceedances.
12
